| [Utilization review](SKILL.md) | Agent Skill | Review whether a deployed or scaled-out use case is actually used and delivers value - "deployed is not used". Fills the utilization table per use case and site, asks "what would make it utilized?", flags the dashboard-without-action-owner smell, reconciles the dashboard with the paper record before it is accepted, decides between "to be evaluated" and "no potential" for a use case with deployments but no saving, and ends in a dated follow-up list. Feeds the savings-forecast gate at the close of a use-case sprint. Drafts the review; the plant owner confirms adoption and a human decides "no potential". Use when a use case has been live for a while, when a use case was implemented in a sprint without a forecast, when the scorecard shows low or NEVER utilization, when a scaled-out use case carries no saving, or when someone asks whether a delivered use case is really in use. |
